text1: The UAV video recording shall have 720p resolution and frame rate.
text2: The UAV video feed shall have 4K resolution and 60Hz frame rate.

text1: The Aviary shall only support autonomous remote missions.
text2: The Aviary supports autonomous and Pilot-directed flights.

text1: The UAV flight range shall be no more than 20 miles.
text2: The UAV flight range shall be no less than 20 miles.

text1: The Pilot shall have pre-recorded visual feedback from the UAV's camera usable for the purpose of navigation and/or surveillance.
text2: The Pilot shall have real-time visual feedback from the UAV's camera.

text1: The UAV video feed shall have 1080p resolution and frame rate.
text2: The camera shall be able to point directly above the Hummingbird and to at most 60 degrees in all direction from pointing directly down.

text1: These are the customer requirements for the Aviary System
text2: These are the System Requirements for the Aviary System of Systems.

text1: The Pilot controller shall be able to define, upload, initiation, follow, and terminate a flight plan to the Hummingbird consisting of a set of waypoints within the flight range of the Hummingbird.
text2: The Pilot controller shall be able to define, upload, initiation, follow and terminate a flight plan to the Hummingbird consisting of a flight vector within the range of the Hummingbird.

text1: The Viewer shall disconnect from the custom communication wireless network when an unauthorized connection is provided by the Aviary SoS.
text2: The Viewer shall connect with the any wireless network available

text1: The Pilot shall have a near real-time visual feedback from the Aviary system camera.
text2: The Pilot shall have real-time visual feedback from the UAV's camera for navigation and surveillance.

text1: The UAV shall support a stealth mode in which it emits no sound during flight, which may be enabled or disabled from the Pilot control.
text2: The UAV shall support a stealth mode in which it emits low light during flight, which may be enabled or disabled from the Pilot control.
